test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence contains an error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

Along with his friend, he walked till the end of the street and came back immediately.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**till**" instead of "**to**."
 
• The correct preposition to indicate reaching a specific point or place is "to".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**he walked to the end of the street**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the part of the sentence where the preposition is used incorrectly.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Along with his friend, he walked to the end of the street and came back immediately."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "for came back immediately"** – This option is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "Near with his friend,"** – This option is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "end by the street,"** – This option is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error with the preposition "till".
